prompt.context: Your client wants to understand the snowboard market in Colorado.
prompt.question: What is the 2013 market size (in revenue) of snowboards in the state of Colorado?

clarifying_info.q: Should I focus on retail sales or rentals?
clarifying_info.a: It is safe to estimate the retail market size for snowboards (not rentals), though considering the rental market as well is a plus.

clarifying_info.q: What is the population of Colorado?
clarifying_info.a: You can estimate it — the US has about 300 million people across 50 states, so average is 6 million per state. Colorado is roughly an average-sized state.

framework: Define scope: retail snowboard market (plus mention rental market as a consideration)
Estimate Colorado population using US total / number of states
Segment population to estimate % who snowboard (age, wealth, macroeconomic factors)
Multiply: Population x % Snowboarders x Avg Price x Replacement Rate to get annual market size

questions.prompt: Walk through your market sizing calculation for Colorado snowboard revenue.
questions.guidance: Candidate should structure the equation: Market size = Population of CO * % Snowboarders * Avg Snowboard Price * Replacement Rate. Strong candidates will segment the population logically (by age and wealth), explain their assumptions, use round numbers, and sanity-check the result. Mentioning the rental market is a plus.

math.setup: Market size = Population of CO x % Snowboarders x Avg Snowboard Price x (1 / Board Lifespan in Years)
steps: US population = 300M, 50 states => avg 6M per state; CO ~ 5M
500,000 snowboarders x $500 avg board price = $250,000,000 total market value
$250M / 5 years avg board life = $50M per year

brainstorming.prompt: What factors should influence your assumptions about the percentage of Coloradans who snowboard?

categories.name: Age Segmentation
ideas: 15-25 year olds have a higher propensity to snowboard than those over 60

categories.name: Wealth / Income Segmentation
ideas: Snowboarding requires lift tickets, equipment, and travel — skewed toward higher-income households
Lower-income households less likely to purchase boards or season passes

categories.name: Macroeconomic Factors
ideas: Demand is elastic — in downturns, consumers reduce discretionary spending on snowboards
Colorado residents have more convenient access to resorts than out-of-state visitors

categories.name: Rental Market
ideas: Resorts purchase boards in bulk to rent to day visitors — represents a separate revenue stream
Good candidate should flag rental market as an additional segment worth sizing

recommendation: Colorado retail snowboard market is estimated at approximately $50 million per year
Key drivers are the 10% snowboarding penetration rate among ~5M residents and a ~5-year board replacement cycle
risks: Assumption of 10% penetration could vary widely (5-20% is defensible range)
Board lifespan assumption (2-10 years) significantly impacts result
Ignoring rental market understates total market opportunity
next_steps: Validate penetration rate with survey or industry data
Size the resort rental market to get a complete picture
Segment by board type (beginner vs. advanced) for richer insight
